pages.text: Launch a block into motion, with configurable speed and collision damage limits.

pages.title: Default Aether Cost
pages.text: 2K + 1K*v*v per block, plus reserved collision damage m(d), for speed v and maximum damage d; this damage allowance is charged on delivery.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1, regardless of damage, effect level or number of targets.

pages.title: Parameters
pages.text: $(li)speed / Required$(br2)$(li)damage Per Block / Optional$(br2)$(li)max Damage / Optional
